intents.line: What ASA grade would you give this patient, and why?
I would call this ASA {asa}, because {why} That is a teaching point, not a mark against you.
I have heard your grade; I will confirm it myself before the list.
The plan is a standard general anaesthetic.
The plan is a rapid sequence induction: this patient is treated as having a full stomach.
The fasting time has not been reached. We should wait until {time}, and the patient needs to be told why.

note: Approved intent table for the anaesthetist (Implementation Guide: the anaesthetist replies from approved intents). {asa} is the grade with an E for an emergency, {why} the case's stated reason, {time} the clock time the fasting rule is met.
